413-1496-1981.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1496-1981.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1456-5078-6633-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-4050-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-4050-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least three charge counters on it.
2757-4687-5115.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate the Forest or Island by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, putting at least three charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4687-4893-5268.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
4687-4893-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

277-1308-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

560-4550-5231-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5231-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

792-1580-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3334-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3334-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Lae'zel.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5434-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-7009-7638.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1308-1563-2457-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1445-2034-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

2464-4222-7065.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-4222-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4508-5880-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4508-5880-6441-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

7-1020-2866-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures excluding Myr Retriever that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1020-2866-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Repeat.

628-2981-7189.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability
Repeat.

483-2438-5170-6132.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-3963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available

Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.

Repeat.

500-1181-2187.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Possessed Skaab and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Possessed Skaab tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Possessed Skaab token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

500-1309-1777.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Salvager of Secrets and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Salvager of Secrets tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Salvager of Secrets token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

4067-4435-6254-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-4435-6254-6827.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

813-2072-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-2072-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

224-1359-1683-3861.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1683-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Orzhov Basilica on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

643-3951-5147-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-5147-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4636-5391-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
4636-5391-5921.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

372-1567-3277.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
372-1567-3277.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2511-2525-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Double, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1458-2608--63.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Derevi that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1458-2608--63.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control except Derevi that does not have summoning sickness.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted in step 1.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast the permanent from your hand by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Resolve the permanent spell.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the permanent cast in step 5 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

972-4131-5647.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-2196-3584.notablePrerequisites:
You have an additional three cards in your graveyard if Frantic Search is in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1368-2196-3584.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search either from your hand by paying {2}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Frantic Search for each instant or sorcery you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the original Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2438-2523-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2438-2523-5515.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1006-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Wylie Duke.
1006-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

2757-3841-4518.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Kor Skyfisher, untapping the Plains.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Human Soldier token, untapping the Plains.
Repeat.

985-3375-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.

1594-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3554-4001-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Razaketh's Rite by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Razaketh's Rite and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
